name: a vendor's own page with a real quote builds a claim
quote: The Function node has been deprecated and replaced by the Code node.

name: MUST REFUSE a claim with no source at all
quote: Acme has been deprecated and will be removed.

name: MUST REFUSE a quote too short to verify
MUST REFUSE a claim with an empty statement
quote: The free tier has been discontinued for new projects.

name: MUST REFUSE an excluded source outright
quote: Acme has been deprecated according to our research team.

name: a third party builds a claim but MUST NOT substantiate a strict kind
quote: Acme told us it will shut the service down next quarter.

name: a registry LENT to a package settles a version and MUST NOT settle a price
quote: langchain 0.3.27 is the latest release on PyPI.

name: that same registry DOES settle the version it exists to publish
quote: langchain 0.3.27 is the latest release on PyPI.

name: MUST NOT strip a vendor of authority over its own site that is also a registry
statement: Hugging Face changed its Spaces pricing
quote: Spaces hardware now starts at $0.60 per hour for the smallest GPU tier.

name: a model card on its own host still settles a deprecation about that model
quote: This model card is deprecated; use Qwen3 instead for new work.

name: a registry that is NOT the subject's site still answers only within its remit
quote: sometool 1.2.0 is the latest release published on PyPI.
